title: Composable provenance coverage union rule
memory_recovered: Partial provenance searches may be composed only as an explicit coverage union. Composition can increase the searched universe, but it cannot erase unknown permissions, inaccessible refs, deleted-path gaps, source-class exclusions, pagination ceilings, or disagreement between search methods.

observed: M-RECONCILE-002 requires exhaustive branch or equivalent history coverage before M-004, M-005, or M-006 can be classified unlocated.
CM-1037 requires machine-readable composition of partial searches and prohibits treating repeated partial searches as exhaustive proof by default.
Current available evidence includes heterogeneous source classes with different search universes and authority levels.
inferred: Coverage is a set-valued property over provenance-capable locations, not a scalar confidence score.
Two individually valid search envelopes can still produce an invalid union when their repository identity, matching rules, temporal snapshot, or permission scope are incompatible.
proposed: Normalize every search result into a coverage envelope before composition.
Compute union coverage dimension-by-dimension and retain overlap, contradiction, exclusion, and unknown sets explicitly.
Permit exhaustive_unlocated only when the union has no capable-location gaps, no unresolved contradictions, no ceilings, and no undeclared exclusions.
superseded: Search count is a sufficient proxy for coverage quality.
Independent searches can be merged by concatenating results alone.
A broader union automatically inherits the strongest terminal status of any member envelope.
unresolved: No retained union envelope yet enumerates every accessible ref, reachable commit, deleted path, decision-log namespace, language-lexicon namespace, project-document namespace, and authorized historical source class relevant to M-004, M-005, and M-006.
The originating assigning source for M-004, M-005, and M-006 remains unlocated.

terminal_status_rules.located_verified: At least one immutable assigning source satisfies namespace, owner, semantic-role, temporal-precedence, and locator agreement, with contradictions adjudicated.
terminal_status_rules.exhaustive_unlocated: Every provenance-capable location in the declared accessible universe is covered; exclusions, unknowns, ceilings, inaccessible refs, deleted-path gaps, and unresolved contradictions are empty.
terminal_status_rules.unresolved_incomplete_coverage: Any provenance-capable location remains uncovered, inaccessible, excluded, ceiling-limited, or permission-ambiguous.
terminal_status_rules.unresolved_conflicting_candidates: Materially qualifying candidates or member results conflict without a retained authority or causal-precedence resolution.

fail_closed_rules: Union terminal status may not be stronger than the weakest unresolved capable-location gap.
Unknown and excluded are distinct from searched-with-zero-results.
Overlapping searches do not increase coverage merely by repetition.
A member envelope with unretained raw results cannot support exhaustive_unlocated.
A later immutable assigning source invalidates any prior exhaustive_unlocated result and requires supersession.

falsification_route: Construct a retained union envelope from independently captured member searches. Demonstrate that all provenance-capable locations are covered with no exclusions, unknown permissions, ceilings, inaccessible refs, deleted-path gaps, or contradictions, then show either a qualifying immutable source or a zero-candidate terminal result. A later qualifying immutable source supersedes and falsifies an exhaustive_unlocated classification.
privacy_boundary: This record contains repository-governance abstractions and continuity identifiers only. It retains no private chat excerpts, health or pet-health material, credentials, identifying personal information, or unreviewed File Library content.
